# Polygon with Hole

A polygon containing an interior ring (hole). Tests that tools correctly distinguish outer and inner rings and compute area accounting for the hole.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `polygon_with_hole` |
| Category | vector |
| Format | GeoJSON |
| Geometry type | Polygon |
| CRS | `EPSG:4326` |
| Test tier | unit |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `geopandas` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("polygon_with_hole")
def test_polygon_with_hole(geocase_case) -> None:
    data = geocase_case.load()
    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Verify that inner rings are preserved on load and that area calculations subtract the hole.
